examples.name: bearing_housing
examples.title: Flanged bearing housing
examples.description: A turned hub on a square flange: a revolved profile dimensioned by diameters about its drawn axis, counterbored holes for M8 cap screws in a circular pattern, fillets and a section through the bore.

examples.name: turned_shaft
examples.title: Turned drive shaft
examples.description: Six diameters on one revolved profile, chained lengths, an M16 cosmetic thread, a keyway cut down to a datum plane and shown in a section, chamfers and corner rounds; drawn at 2:1.

examples.name: manifold_block
examples.title: Hydraulic manifold block
examples.description: Drilled ports that meet inside an aluminium block: a spot-faced pressure port, a counterbored and a countersunk side port, four tapped M6 holes, and two sections that show the bores meet.

examples.name: cast_bracket
examples.title: Cast angle bracket
examples.description: An L profile extruded both ways, a 2° casting draft, a rib and mounting slots each made once and mirrored, an H7 bore, and fillets on every inside corner.

examples.name: sheet_metal_cover
examples.title: Vented sheet-metal cover
examples.description: Driven by named values you can change on the command line: a base with flanges and inward lips bent along its edges, a row of vent slots, mounting holes, and its flat pattern on a sheet of its own.

examples.name: axial_fan
examples.title: Axial fan
examples.description: A turned hub and five twisted blades: one blade lofted from a root section to a tip section, each pitched at its own angle, and a circular feature pattern; a section shows the tip's pitch.

examples.name: pipe_elbow
examples.title: Flanged 90° pipe elbow
examples.description: A tube swept along a bend, a flange with four bolt holes, and the flange with its holes mirrored onto the other end in the plane that halves the bend.

examples.name: bearing_unit
examples.title: Bearing unit (assembly)
examples.description: A housing, a shaft turning in two catalogue 6204 bearings, a cover held by four catalogue M5 cap screws: joints, a part pattern, a section through the axis, a parts list and balloons.

examples.name: caster
examples.title: Caster (assembly)
examples.description: A shelled steel fork, a wheel of two bodies (aluminium hub, rubber tyre) each weighing by its own material, and an axle pin; the wheel turns on a revolute joint.

examples.name: butt_hinge
examples.title: Butt hinge (assembly)
examples.description: One brass leaf part placed twice, the second turned end for end so the knuckles interleave, a steel pin, and a revolute joint driven open to 110°; knuckles, reliefs and countersunk holes are each one feature and a pattern.

examples.name: bench_vise
examples.title: Bench vise (assembly)
examples.description: A cast body and moving jaw and an M12 screw: the jaw slides on the body, the screw turns in it, and a Drive step opens the vise to a width; built open and nearly shut, its section draws the screw whole.
